title: 12 can coolers
text: 12 can coolers. These are great.  They are thin.  But I didn't want to store thick ones.  They do the trick on a bottle/can - for about an hour - or about what you would expect I think.  On the wider bottles they will fit, but I recommend stuffing the bottle in and THEN opening the bottle so you aren't spilling.  The colors are bright and vibrant.  I think the price was fair.  So... win win
